metadata.mechanics: Upon completion, up to 5 Targets gain "Upsurge: 3 uses of 'Next attempted Strike deals 10 Rad damage.'" If a Target enters Bleedout while still under the effect of the Upsurge, they must call "Area of Effect 5 Rad, Inflict Stage 1 Radiation Rot." Any unused Strikes granted by the Upsurge are also expended, increasing the damage of the Bleedout-triggered AoE call  by 10 for each remaining use.
metadata.requirementsToUse: Lore: Faith - Common OR Profession: Saint. User must be Inducted into the Church of Darwin
metadata.validTargetDescription: Up to 5 Targets Inducted into the Church of Darwin
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: 20 minutes of role-play where Targets are subjected to sources of radiation, such as handling irradiated objects or proximity near glowing artifacts while engaging in activities that represent extreme physical exertion and pushing their body and mind to its outer limit. The user of this benediction guides the focus of the "breaking and rebuilding" of the mind, body, and soul in the glow of radiation.
